target_applications: hazardous-work substitution (dangerous materials, radiation, ALMA telescope maintenance), future space/lunar teleoperation

base_type.value: tracked — CuboRex CuGo MEGA electric crawlers (independent battery); demoed on Kubota KATV all-terrain vehicle

dof_total.source: https://jp.mathworks.com/company/user_stories/advancing-robotics-design-with-model-based-design.html (some summaries cite 35 DoF, likely earlier gen)

end_effector.value: multi-finger hands, dynamic range cream-puff-delicate to 20kg; object axis aligned to wrist rotation axis; auto wrist-rotation for tool use (M6 bolt fastening)

sensors_wrist_hand.value: hand load/moment sensing rendered as visual-haptic feedback to operator

compute.value: control electronics housed in torso; controllers auto-generated via Simulink/Embedded Coder

software_stack.value: proprietary master-slave teleop with custom intuitive operation device; MATLAB/Simulink Model-Based Design; operator-training real-time sim

safety_compliance.value: prototype; operator-in-loop with force/moment visual feedback

availability.value: not for sale; practical use targeted FY2025+

deployment_evidence.value: no commercial deployments; verified tasks: plug insertion ~4min, M6 bolt fastening, zipper-bag opening ~2min; Kansai Robot World 2024 demo with Kubota

notes: One of very few tracked semi-humanoids. DoF conflict: 42 (MathWorks case study) vs 35 (discovery-note figure, likely earlier generation). Formerly required wired 3-phase 200V AC; now 48V battery.
